listing.title: ADHD Printable Planner Kit – Today Page, Energy Planner & Focus Sheets (Undated, A4 + US Letter)
listing.description:
Simple paper pages for adults with ADHD or time blindness. Plan by anchors and energy, not by the clock.

WHAT'S INSIDE (14 pages)
- Today page – time anchors, Top 3 (only 3), now / next / later, guess vs real time, 16 focus blocks (15 min each), tomorrow's first step, brain dump
- Energy-Based Daily Plan + Low-Energy Reset Sheet (for hard days)
- Weekly Capacity & Rhythm, Weekly Overview, Weekly Reset & Clear Out
- Monthly Review
- Brain Dump & Sort, Unload & Sort, Daily Focus Sheet
- Project Micro-Step Breakdown
- Notes & Reflections
- Cover with "What's inside" + How to use page

YOU GET
- 2 PDF files: A4 and US Letter (14 pages each)
- Undated – start any day, print as many times as you need
- Instant download – nothing is shipped

GOOD TO KNOW
- Printable PDF, not editable
- For personal use only
- A planning tool, not medical advice
- Designed with help from AI tools and checked page by page by a person
listing.buyer: adults with ADHD or time blindness who like simple printable planners

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Start each day with the Today page. On hard days, use the Low-Energy Reset Sheet instead.
When your head feels full, use the Brain Dump & Sort page, then move three things to the Daily Focus Sheet.
Plan the week with the Weekly Overview and look back with the Monthly Review.
cover_image_idea: The Today page and the Energy-Based Daily Plan page on soft pastel paper.
